jobs.text: The Chittagong Hill Tracts are home to eleven indigenous peoples, including the Chakma, Marma and Tripura, each with its own language and festivals. Kaptai Lake was formed in the early 1960s when a dam was built on the Karnaphuli river. It flooded a large area of farmland and forced many thousands of people to leave their homes.
